metadata.purpose: Profiler questions in plain language. Each question carries an id and a SHARE variable (var). When multiple questions share a var, the Quiz aggregates per the aggregations map below before passing answers to matchProfile().
metadata.audience: Anyone — designed to be answerable without specialist knowledge.

questions.prompt: How would you rate your overall health right now?
questions.helper: Self-rated health on the standard five-step scale (1 = excellent, 5 = poor).

questions.prompt: Over the last month, how often have you felt sad, depressed, or in low spirits?
questions.helper: First of three short questions that together approximate the EURO-D depression scale.

questions.prompt: How often do you find pleasure in things you used to enjoy — hobbies, conversation, food, family time?
questions.helper: Anhedonia component. Higher when pleasure is reduced or absent.
Sleep disturbance is a core depression marker.

questions.prompt: Which best describes your independence in daily tasks like cooking, taking medication, shopping, or managing money?
questions.helper: IADL count: 0 = fully independent; higher means help is needed in more areas.

options.label: Fully independent in all of them
Need a little help with one task
Need help with two or three tasks
Need help with four or more
Need help with all of them

questions.prompt: At the end of the month, how easily does your household make ends meet?
In the last 7 days, have you used the internet for any reason — email, news, messaging, banking, video calls?
questions.helper: Even a single use in the past week counts as Yes.

questions.prompt: How many people are in your close circle — family or friends you'd talk to about something important?
questions.helper: Pick the option closest to your situation. Acquaintances and casual contacts don't count.

questions.prompt: When you speak, how easily do words come to you — finding the right word, names, places?
questions.helper: Self-rated proxy for verbal fluency. Replaces the 60-second animal-naming test that doesn't work in a static form.

options.label: Sometimes I have to search a moment
Often I struggle to find the word
Frequently the word just won't come

questions.prompt: How often do you feel in control of your life and your decisions?
questions.helper: Control subscale of CASP-12. First of four questions on quality of life.

questions.prompt: How free do you feel to do what you want with your time and your day?
How often do you find what you do enjoyable and rewarding?
How often do you feel you're doing things that matter to you and that you're learning or growing?
How often do you feel lonely?
questions.helper: UCLA loneliness short scale (3 = hardly ever, 9 = often).

questions.prompt: Do you have things you look forward to or hope for in the coming years?
questions.helper: Whether the respondent reports forward-looking hope.
